premise: Flower will not open one grey morning; fanning, tickling and pulling fail; Bee hums beside her until the sun comes and the petals open on their own.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop): what force cannot open, warmth does; here the warmth is a friend's patient hum and then the real sun.
lesson: Some things open only when they are ready; stay close and wait.
learning: Some flowers close their petals at night and open again in the sun.

en-US.title: Bee and the Sleepy Flower
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {butterfly:float loop 0.3} The morning was grey, and Flower {flower:pulse} was still closed up tight, petals folded like a little fist. [curious] Wake up, Flower! said Bee. It is morning! Flower did not move. Butterfly {butterfly:wobble} fanned her with both wings. {sfx:fan} Whoosh, whoosh. Nothing. Ladybug {ladybug:hop} tickled her stem. Nothing. Bee tried pulling a petal, very gently. Flower held on tighter. [softly] Then Bee stopped pulling. She sat down on a leaf beside her, and hummed. {sfx:hum} Hmmmm. A slow, warm, sunny hum. Butterfly landed too. And while they waited, the grey went thin… and thinner… {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} and the sun came through. It touched Flower's top petal. [gasps] One petal opened. Then two. Then all of them, {flower:glow} wide and yellow and awake. Good morning, said Flower. I always sleep until the sun comes. [happily] Bee laughed, and hummed a little louder.

es-ES.title: Abeja y la flor dormilona
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {butterfly:float loop 0.3} La mañana estaba gris, y Flor {flower:pulse} seguía cerrada, con los pétalos apretados como un puñito. [curious] ¡Despierta, Flor!, dijo Abeja. ¡Ya es de día! Flor no se movió. Mariposa {butterfly:wobble} la abanicó con las dos alas. {sfx:fan} Fiu, fiu. Nada. Mariquita {ladybug:hop} le hizo cosquillas en el tallo. Nada. Abeja tiró de un pétalo, con mucho cuidado. Flor se cerró más fuerte. [softly] Entonces Abeja dejó de tirar. Se sentó en una hoja, a su lado, y se puso a zumbar. {sfx:hum} Mmmmm. Un zumbido lento, cálido, de sol. Y mientras esperaban, el gris se fue haciendo fino… y más fino… {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} y el sol se abrió paso. Tocó el pétalo de arriba. [gasps] Se abrió un pétalo. Luego dos. Luego todos, {flower:glow} amarillos, abiertos y despiertos. Buenos días, dijo Flor. Yo siempre duermo hasta que sale el sol. [happily] Abeja se rio, y zumbó un poquito más fuerte.

fan.prompt: two soft flaps of butterfly wings fanning the air, a light whoosh whoosh

hum.prompt: a single bee humming softly and steadily, warm and low, close by
